colors.name: Colors
colors.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#colors).

fonts.name: Fonts
fonts.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#fonts).

font_base_size.name: Font base size
font_base_size.help: Allows to define the size for the fonts of the theme.

design.name: Design
design.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#design).

theme_store_name.name: Custom name
theme_store_name.help: Allows to replace the original **Store name** in the **Header**, **Footer** and **Mobile Menu**, which will be the one defined at `Settings > General > Preferences`. This will not display if a Logo has been uploaded in those sections.

theme_store_name_size.name: Size
theme_store_name_size.help: Allows to define the size of the **Store name**. Size will vary depending on the section where it's displayed.

theme_store_name_weight.name: Weight
theme_store_name_weight.help: Allows to define the font weight of the **Store name**.

theme_spacing.name: Spacing
theme_spacing.help: Allows to define the amount of space between blocks, like for example **Banners**, **Products**, **Articles**, among others.

theme_corners_style.name: Rounded corners
theme_corners_style.help: Choose the corner style that sections and components of the theme will have. This affects elements like **Slides**, **Banners**, **Images**, **Category blocks**, **Product blocks**, **Accordions**, among others.

theme_button_style.name: Style
theme_button_style.help: Choose the style for buttons to use in the store. This also affects store's **Header** and **Navbar** elements.

theme_border_style.name: Style
theme_border_style.help: Choose which style of line you would like to use in the store. This also affects items of the Store's Header and Navbar.

theme_icon_style.name: Style
theme_icon_style.help: Allows to define the style for the icons across the theme.

theme_icon_cart.name: Cart icon
theme_icon_cart.help: Allows to define the icon of 'Cart' that will be used across the theme.

theme_icon_cart_button.name: Show Cart icon in buttons
theme_icon_cart_button.help: The icon will be displayed on the **Add to Cart** buttons visible on **Product blocks** and in the **Product page** form.

theme_animate_repeat.name: Animate once
theme_animate_repeat.help: If enabled, the animation will only occur one time when the section or element shows on the browser window.

theme_animate_delay.name: Delay
theme_animate_delay.help: Allows to define the amount of miliseconds for which the animation will wait to be executed.

breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#breadcrumbs).

headings.name: Headings
headings.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#headings).

text_alignment_heading_desktop.name: Desktop
text_alignment_heading_desktop.help: Allows to define the alignment for desktop devices.

text_alignment_heading_mobile.name: Mobile
text_alignment_heading_mobile.help: Allows to define the alignment for mobile devices.

heading_title_size.name: Size
heading_title_size.help: Size for all Theme Titles, such as the ones that can be found in **Components**, **Category**, **Product** and **Pages**. The size will vary depending on the **Font Base Size** that was defined.

heading_title_weight.name: Weight
heading_title_weight.help: To know more about how each weight numerical values are converted, check [this article](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/font-weight#common_weight_name_mapping).

heading_title_spacing.name: Letter spacing
heading_title_spacing.help: Allows to define the space between letters.

heading_subtitle_weight.name: Weight
heading_subtitle_weight.help: To know more about how each weight numerical values are converted, check [this article](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/font-weight#common_weight_name_mapping).

heading_subtitle_spacing.name: Letter spacing
heading_subtitle_spacing.help: Allows to define the space between letters.

heading_description_size.name: Size
heading_description_size.help: Size of the description that displays after a title in the theme.

filters.name: Filters
filters.help: Available only for Premium Plan or above. For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#filters).

filters_behavior.name: Apply on click
filters_behavior.help: This behavior will only work on desktop devices.

filters_counter.name: Show filters counter
filters_counter.help: Allows to display the amount of products within each filter option.

filters_limit.name: Limit amount of filters items
filters_limit.help: Allows to limit the amount of visible items within each filter group.

filters_limit_amount.name: Amount of visible items
filters_limit_amount.help: Number of visible items within each filter group.

product-block.name: Product block
product-block.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#product-block).

pb_content_order.name: Content order
pb_content_order.help: Allows to define the order for the elements in the product block **content area**. **Colors** will display here as long as `Color options position` is **Content area**.

pb_name_size.name: Size
pb_name_size.help: Allows to define the size of all product block's names, which will affect the rest of the elements based on percentages.

pb_name_weight.name: Weight
pb_name_weight.help: Allows to define the products name font weight.

pb_name_spacing.name: Letter spacing
pb_name_spacing.help: Allows to define the space between letters.

pb_show_buttons_status.name: Show status buttons
pb_show_buttons_status.help: Displays a button for users to go to the product page when the status is **Not available** or **Out of stock**.

pb_show_buttons_hover.name: Show 'Add to cart' button on hover

pb_price_from_until.name: Show 'from/until' text for variants
pb_price_from_until.help: Allows to display a text for products where variant's prices may vary.

pb_price_tax.name: Show tax indicator
pb_price_tax.help: Allows to display a text next to the price indicating that the final price is plus tax. If the checkout tax settings indicate that the products already include tax, this text will not be displayed.

pb_price_tax_range.name: Show label only in max price
pb_price_tax_range.help: If the Variants price display is **Range**, the label will be displayed only in the higher price.

pb_labels_font_size.name: Size
pb_labels_font_size.help: Allows to define the font size of all product blocks labels.

pb_labels_shape.name: Shape
pb_labels_shape.help: Applies to all product block labels with the exception of the **Discount** one, which has its own options.

pb_label_new_limit.name: Threshold
pb_label_new_limit.help: Allows to define the amount of days for a product to be considered 'new' and show the label on them.

pb_card_image_padding.name: Image padding
pb_card_image_padding.help: When enabled the image will separate from the edges of the product card.

presentation.help: These colors allow to customize the button that displays on top of the image.
presentation.name: Quick view colors

presentation.help: Defines which product details will be displayed in the **Content area** of blocks.
presentation.name: Information

presentation.help: The following options apply for the **Quick View** and **Wishlist** buttons that can be enabled within product blocks.
presentation.name: Action buttons style

product-quick-view.name: Product Quick view
product-quick-view.help: This feature lets your customers preview product details without leaving the page they're at, making browsing faster and easier. For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#product-block).

product-form.name: Product form
product-form.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#product-form).

pf_qty_select.name: Quantity selector
pf_qty_select.help: If enabled, the product quantity selector will be visible.

pf_buy_now_button.name: 'Buy now' button
pf_buy_now_button.help: It displays a button to redirect your clients directly to the checkout after adding to the cart.

pf_buy_now_button_main.name: Set 'Buy now' as main
pf_buy_now_button_main.help: Allows to display the **Buy now** button before **Add to cart**.

pf_buy_now_button_hide_disabled.name: Hide 'Buy now' when disabled
pf_buy_now_button_hide_disabled.help: Makes the **Buy now** button to be automatically hidden when the action is not possible to perform.

pf_first_gallery_image.name: Start on first gallery image
pf_first_gallery_image.help: If enabled, the product gallery will start on the first image instead of the image associated with the product variant.

pf_price_tax.name: Show tax indicator
pf_price_tax.help: Allows to display a text next to the price indicating that the final amount considers tax. If the checkout tax settings indicate that the products already include tax, this text will not be displayed.

whatsapp-button.name: WhatsApp button
whatsapp-button.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#whatsapp-button).

store_whatsapp_message_hide.name: Days to remain closed
store_whatsapp_message_hide.help: Indicate the number of days that the call to action message will remain closed, thus improving the navigation of your visitors. If 0, it will remain open.

store_whatsapp_contact.name: Contact
store_whatsapp_contact.help: This text will be sent on all pages except the product page unless the contact message for the product page is defined.

store_whatsapp_contact_product.name: Product page
store_whatsapp_contact_product.help: This message is used only on product pages. The message will be sent together with the product name and url.
store_whatsapp_contact_product.default: I would like to know more about this product

add-to-cart-notification.name: Add to cart notification
add-to-cart-notification.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#add-to-cart-notification).

display_cart_notification.name: Enable
display_cart_notification.help: Displays a message on the page notifying customers that the product was added to the cart. Overrides redirection options in your checkout preferences.

cart_notification_position.name: Position
cart_notification_position.help: Allows to choose the position in which the notification will be displayed.

age-verification-popup.name: Age verification popup
age-verification-popup.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#age-verification-popup).

av_popup.name: Enable
av_popup.help: If enabled, the message will be displayed in all theme pages.

av_popup_content.name: Text
av_popup_content.help: Here you can add the content for the message.
av_popup_content.default: You must be of legal age to view our website. Due to legal requirements you must verify your age.

av_popup_button_accept.name: Accept button
av_popup_button_accept.help: Text for the accept button. If visitors click this button, the message will not be displayed again.

av_popup_button_reject_redirect.name: Redirect link
av_popup_button_reject_redirect.help: Link to redirect visitors if they click the reject button.

cookie-consent.name: Cookie consent banner
cookie-consent.help: Marketing cookies require an active Google Tag Manager account configured in [Settings > General > Preferences](/admin/settings/general).

cc_banner.name: Enable
cc_banner.help: If enabled, the message will be displayed in all theme pages.

t_cc_description.name: Description
t_cc_description.default: This website uses cookies to ensure you get the best experience.

t_cc_necessary_desc.name: Necessary: description
t_cc_necessary_desc.default: These cookies are essential for the website to function and cannot be disabled.

t_cc_performance_desc.name: Performance: description
t_cc_performance_desc.default: They help us understand how users interact with the site and improve its performance.

t_cc_customization_desc.name: Customization: description
t_cc_customization_desc.default: They help remember your preferences and provide content tailored to you.

t_cc_marketing_desc.name: Marketing: description
t_cc_marketing_desc.default: They are used to deliver relevant ads and measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns.

cc_banner_link.name: Privacy link
cc_banner_link.help: If a link is provided, a box with a link to the **Privacy policies** will be displayed in the banner.

articles.name: Articles
articles.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#blog).

article_block_content_order.name: Content order
article_block_content_order.help: Allows to define the order for the elements in the **Content area** of articles.

article_block_title_size.name: Size
article_block_title_size.help: Allows to define the size for all articles titles, which will affect the rest of the elements based on percentages.

article_block_title_weight.name: Weight
article_block_title_weight.help: Allows to define the title weight.

article_block_title_spacing.name: Letter spacing
article_block_title_spacing.help: Allows to define the space between letters.

shopping-process.name: Shopping Process
shopping-process.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#shopping-process).

cart_bundle_color.name: Content colors
cart_bundle_color.help: Allows to define the color pack for all shopping process pages (Cart, Checkout, Review and Success) when **Classic** checkout form is being used. For the case of the **Standard** version, this option will only affect the **Cart** page.

cart_logo.name: Custom logo
cart_logo.help: If no logo it's uploaded here, the one from `Settings > General > Branding` will be displayed. If there's no logo at all, the **Store name** will show.

cart_sidebar.name: Show sidebar
cart_sidebar.help: If disabled, the **Cart item** in the theme's **Header** will be a link to the cart page.

cart_sidebar_icon.name: Show icon
cart_sidebar_icon.help: Allows to display an icon next to the menu title.

cart_sidebar_actions.name: Buttons priority
cart_sidebar_actions.help: Allows to define which of the buttons of the menu will be the one with higher priority to customers.

cart_success_message_text.name: Text
cart_success_message_text.default: If you have any question about it or need help, send us an email:

cart_success_link.name: Link
cart_success_link.help: Allows to display an email or link after the message text.

presentation.help: The **Custom Logo** will only be visible on the Cart, Checkout and Review pages for the **Classic** checkout form version. For the case of the **Standard** version, this will only be visible on the **Cart** page.
presentation.name: Logo

presentation.help: This will only be applied if your store is using the **Classic** checkout form version.
presentation.name: Success page

social-media.name: Social media
social-media.help: Your Social Media channel links must be added in [Settings > General > Preferences](/admin/settings/generalstore_info). for the buttons to be displayed.

fs_mobile.name: Show on mobile
fs_mobile.help: Decide if links will be displayed on mobile devices.

fs_position.name: Position
fs_position.help: Define the position of the floating social media buttons.

presentation.help: Allows to display a floating bar with social media buttons on your store.
presentation.name: Floating Links

custom-codes.name: Custom codes
custom-codes.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#custom-codes).

head_code_top.name: Top <head> code
head_code_top.help: Embed code at the start of the <head> tag

head_code_bottom.name: Bottom <head> code
head_code_bottom.help: Embed code at the end of the <head> tag

body_code_top.name: Top <body> code
body_code_top.help: Embed code at the start of the <body> tag

body_code_bottom.name: Bottom <body> code
body_code_bottom.help: Embed code at the end of the <body> tag

disable-shopping-features.name: Disable shopping features
disable-shopping-features.help: For more information about this section and its options, please visit [this article](/admin/landing?url=/support/theme-customization/#disable-shopping-features).

disable_shopping_cart_text.name: Text
disable_shopping_cart_text.default: It's not possible to purchase products at the moment. If you need more information please contact us through our different channels.

presentation.help: Will be displayed on the `Product form` both within product pages and `Selected product` component.
presentation.name: Message

translations.name: Theme translations
translations.help: These text strings will replace the main text of your theme, if you have more languages active in your shop, you can translate them in the [Languages](/admin/languages) section of your admin panel.

t_continue_shopping.name: Continue shopping
t_continue_shopping.help: Used on the product page to go back when the product doesn't have stock.

t_sidebar_calculation_text.name: Shipping and taxes calculation
t_sidebar_calculation_text.help: Text that displays before the buttons to inform customers that Shipping & Taxes will be finally calculated at the Checkout. If not needed, just leave this field empty.
t_sidebar_calculation_text.default: Shipping costs will be calculated at Checkout.

t_see_availability.name: See availability
t_see_availability.help: Text displayed on product block buttons when its type is `Appointment`.

t_sort_by.name: Sort by
t_sort_by.help: Used on filters and product reviews.

t_success_adding_to_cart.name: Success message after adding to the Cart
t_success_adding_to_cart.help: Used on add to cart notifications.

t_view_all.name: View all
t_view_all.help: Used on navigation menu deeper levels.

t_price_tax.name: + tax
t_price_tax.help: The label can be enabled on product form and product block.

t_price_without_tax_message.name: Price without tax message
t_price_without_tax_message.help: The message displayed when the price is shown without tax.

t_already_have_an_account.name: Already have an account?
t_already_have_an_account.default: Already have an account? Log in here

t_billing_same_as_shipping.name: Billing Information same as Shipping
t_billing_same_as_shipping.default: Your Billing Information is the same as your Shipping Information.

t_check_this.name: Check this out
t_check_this.help: Used on the product form to share a product by WhatsApp.

t_choose_a_time_slot.name: Choose a time slot
t_choose_a_time_slot.help: Displayed on appointment products to prompt customers to select a time slot.

t_discount_off.name: Discount off
t_discount_off.help: Used on the volume prices on product form to indicate the discount amount.

t_estimate_shipping.name: Estimate shipping costs
t_estimate_shipping.help: Available in the shipping estimation form.

t_go_to.name: Go to
t_go_to.help: Used on many links in the theme to indicate an action.

t_not_available_pf_text.name: 'Not available' message
t_not_available_pf_text.help: 'Not available' message text on product form.
t_not_available_pf_text.default: This product is currently unavailable. You may send us an inquiry about it.

t_out_of_stock_pf_text.name: 'Out of stock' message
t_out_of_stock_pf_text.help: 'Out of stock' message text on product form.
t_out_of_stock_pf_text.default: This product has run out of stock. You may send us an inquiry about it.

t_from_filter.name: 'From' on filters
t_from_filter.help: The 'from' indicator on the product filters.

t_from.name: 'From' label on product block
t_from.help: The 'from' indicator of the price range in the product block.

t_have_a_discount_code.name: Have a discount code?
t_have_a_discount_code.help: Used on the coupon code form.

t_have_a_discount_or_gift_card_code.name: Have a discount or gift card code?
t_have_a_discount_or_gift_card_code.help: Used on the coupon code form.
t_have_a_discount_or_gift_card_code.default: Have a discount or gift card code?

t_have_a_gift_card_code.name: Have a gift card code?
t_have_a_gift_card_code.help: Used on the coupon code form.

t_to_filter.name: 'To' label on product block
t_to_filter.help: The 'until' indicator on the product filters.

t_try_removing_filters.name: Try removing or using different filters
t_try_removing_filters.default: Try removing or using different filters.

t_try_searching_or_go_home.name: Try with other keywords label
t_try_searching_or_go_home.default: Try searching with other keywords or go back to the Home page.

t_until.name: Until
t_until.help: The 'until' indicator of the price range in the product block.

t_cart_empty.name: Your cart is currently empty
t_cart_empty.help: Used on the cart page when there are no products in the cart.

t_category_error_title.name: Category error title
t_category_error_title.default: There are still no products available here

t_category_error_text.name: Category error title message
t_category_error_text.default: You can try looking at other categories or use the search bar to find other products.

t_search_error_text.name: Search error message
t_search_error_text.default: We haven't found any products that match your search for

t_no_products_matched.name: No products matched the selected filters
t_no_products_matched.default: No products matched the selected filters

t_no_timeslots.name: No timeslots available message
t_no_timeslots.default: No timeslots available for this date.
